title: Lost Mary BM600 Pink Lemonade Prefilled Vape Pods 20mg - 2PK
description: The Pink Lemonade Lost Mary BM600 Prefilled Pods combine tangy Lemonade with a subtle berry sweetness. The result is a fizzy, fruit-forward flavour that’s lively and uplifting. Each pack contains two 2ml pods prefilled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, delivering up to 600 puffs per pod depending on use. With their smooth mouth-to-lung (MTL) draw, these pods provide a simple yet satisfying vaping experience. Made for the Lost Mary BM600 Prefilled Pod Kit, they install quickly and cleanly: click a pod into place and enjoy consistent fizz and fruit flavour.
